liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Deal** (1 review): Donna's vocals are described as flat and off-key, ruining the performance [13]
- **Samson And Delilah** (1 review): The second set performance is highlighted as a standout moment of the show [15]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): The transition into Fire is praised for its hard rock energy and mellow beauty [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-04-08.sbd.betty.wbotb.83404.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 171 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: A dropout occurs at 3:32, missing five to ten seconds of music [1]
- **gd1978-04-08.148615.mtx.seamons.ht118.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 177 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: An audio cut is present in the first part of the song; Twenty seconds of distortion and fluctuation are present in the source [3]
- **gd1978-04-08.sbd.miller.83716.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 169 min; rated 4/5 by 13 [4]. Said about its sound: Bass jumps out in the middle of the room during the track; One of Phil's upper guitar strings sounds exceedingly flat on the recording; Jerry's tone is described as very fat during the first solo [17][21][22]
- **gd1978-04-08.148006.sbd.betty.dalton.miller.sirmick.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 171 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- Bobby leads Donna into the chorus then quickly changes the arrangement [18]
- A Close Encounters tease is included within the Space section [5]
- This version is compared to the Atlanta show, with a better transition jam [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-04-08.sbd.betty.wbotb.83404.flac16**: taped by Betty Cantor; transferred by Jace and Tim Diebert; source: 7" Betty Board Reel @ 7 1/2 ips > PCM501ES > Fostex D5 > optical S/PDIF out (Jace's tape) > disk [1]. Also: Original SHNs were created in 2002 but are not in circulation [1]
- **gd1978-04-08.148615.mtx.seamons.ht118.flac16**: source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons [3]
- **gd1978-04-08.sbd.miller.83716.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> PCM -> Dat (44.1k) D [4]
- **gd1978-04-08.148006.sbd.betty.dalton.miller.sirmick.flac16**: taped by Betty Cantor;Tim Dalton; transferred by Sirmick and Charlie Miller; source: Source: SBD Master Reel (7" two track @ 7 1/2 ips - recorded by Betty Cantor) > PCM501ES @ 44.055 kHz > DAT (44k) - From the Tim Dalton collection. [2]
